upstream_cli.setup: pip install -r requirements.txt (upstream documents a Python 3.11 environment)
upstream_cli.note: Taken from the upstream README. Confirm against the pinned commit before a run, and record the config used in the run's provenance.

notes: commit is null until pinned: set it to a full 40-character SHA, then add each attack-case and agent-definition file to files with its SHA-256 so a run cannot score against content that drifted.
ASB is used from a clone rather than a package, so the pinned commit is the only version identifier.
Upstream runs Python 3.11; the ACF SDK needs 3.10 or newer, so one environment can host both.
